correctness.rationale: The infinite nearest-neighbor host recurrence has essential squared-frequency band [kappa,kappa+4]. Strictly positive quadratic form for kappa,kappa0,mu>0 removes nonpositive eigenvalues; unit-modulus recurrence excludes embedded and band-edge square-summable modes. Outside the band the only allowed symmetric tails are p^|n| and (-q)^|n|, with 0<p,q<1. Defect matching yields two linear equations in (mu,kappa0); subtraction gives mu=2pq/(1+pq), and kappa0=2[kappa pq-(1-p)(1+q)]/(1+pq). Hence physical positivity iff kappa pq>(1-p)(1+q). F(r) is strictly decreasing on (-1,0),(0,1); its end signs show one simple localized eigenvalue on each side and none else. Equality gives excluded kappa0=0, not a physical impurity. The actual checker and an independent high precision four-pair reconstruction independently verify matching equations and feasible/infeasible boundaries; finite spectra do not prove the all-chain claims.
